api_timings.measurement: Browser request event through complete response-body receipt; network, gateway, server and harness interception included. Not render time or isolated SQL time.
api_timings.cache_state: mixed cold/warm; cache, connection and function warmth were not controlled
api_timings.percentile_method: nearest rank within each role/contract/status/outcome group
api_timings.sample_policy: First 5000 eligible settled requests; at most 128 tracked concurrently
api_timings.timeline_measurement: Offsets are relative to this browser observer, not wall-clock time. In-flight counts cover only tracked allowlisted browser requests, not active SQL connections or concurrent database queries. Cancelled/failed end offsets record browser termination; unfinished requests have no observed end. Timeline uses the existing sample cap.

people.scope: Four separately created business profiles through real forms; Tailor/SubTailor managed by own FM, Team/SC by Admin. Queued account intents remain unexecuted; no Auth provisioning or mail claimed.

relationships.scope: Two new source-only business profiles, no login provisioning; no existing order routing changed. Automatic approval flag only, not automatic onboarding outcome; no zone routing, bulk reassignment, coordinator-request review or notification delivery claimed.

workflow-extensions.scope: Five finite missing branches; one extra owned source Customer, one four-piece custom order, existing new managed subjects, one task and its existing preset rename. All effects use actual UI. Main Customer request is rejected; bulk routing only isolated no-order Customers. No provider/notification worker or general queue execution.

scope: Real browser commands on disposable staged personas; workers paused; no provider, email, cutover or document rendering acceptance
